thread:
amy-pm: Solstice SI hit a hard stop on marketplace validation for customer Helios. Go-live depends on this. Need an architecture quick triage and escalation.
derek-se: What error are they seeing?
amy-pm: Partner log: "AccessDenied: assumed-role/solstice-marketplace is not authorized to perform: ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer" then later "KMS Decrypt AccessDenied".
nina-eng: Two likely issues: missing scoped ECR read on the replica role, and KMS key policy not allowing that external principal. Also verify replication target region/partition.
omar-sre: I'll try a quick repro in staging by assuming their role. DM creds to me if you can.
partner-ops: DM sent with short-lived creds and role ARN.
derek-se: Quick IAM snippet to test locally (scoped): ```json
{
  "Effect":"Allow",
  "Action":["ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer","ecr:BatchGetImage"],
  "Resource":"arn:aws:ecr:us-gov-west-1:111111111:repository/marketplace/solstice/*"
}
```
omar-sre: Staging pull failed on GetDownloadUrlForLayer. After adding scoped ECR read it moved then failed on KMS:Decrypt. Logs: https://s3.redwood.internal/solstice/helios/replicate-3172001234.log
reena-sec: If we add the partner role to the KMS key policy we need a timeboxed exception and audit. I can approve a scoped 4-hour exception with org-owner CC.
nina-eng: Partner prefers fast unblock. Short-term plan: apply scoped ECR perms + temporary KMS entry, run staging validation, then prod canary tonight. Long-term: re-encrypt-on-replication so we own GovCloud key.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job 'solstice-replicate-staging' at 12:40 UTC -> https://deploy.redwood.dev/jobs/solstice-replicate-staging
omar-sre: Staging validation succeeded after temporary key entry. Partner reports marketplace webhook passed.
reena-sec: Filed ticket SEC-5377 to 1) auto-revert the KMS policy after 4h, 2) add alerting for cross-account decrypt, 3) schedule key re-encrypt migration.
amy-pm: Next steps: a) prod canary 22:00 UTC (derek-se + omar-sre), b) revert key policy after validation (reena-sec), c) follow-up infra work for re-encrypt plan (nina-eng). I'll update partner and close thread after canary.
derek-se: I'll own the canary and rollback playbook.
partner-ops: Partner confirmed contingency AMI if canary fails. Thanks for the quick support. :thumbsup:
